definitions.explanation: The lane on the left side of the road. In Japan, where vehicles drive on the left, the left lane is typically the slower, regular-traffic lane.

examples.japanese: {左車線|ひだりしゃせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{走|はし}って→走る：00519_hashiru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please drive in the left lane.

examples.japanese: ⟦{高速道路|こうそくどうろ}→高速道路：09242_kousokudouro⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{左車線|ひだりしゃせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{走行|そうこう}{車線|しゃせん}→走行車線：24736_soukoushasen⟧になっている。
examples.english: On the expressway, the left lane is the driving lane.

examples.japanese: ⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{出口|でぐち}→出口：02508_deguchi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{降|お}りる→降りる：00568_oriru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦そろそろ→そろそろ：01259_sorosoro⟧{左車線|ひだりしゃせん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{移|うつ}った→移る：01232_utsuru⟧⟦ほうがいい→ほうがいい：10078_hougaii⟧。
examples.english: We're getting off at the next exit, so we should move to the left lane soon.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{左|ひだり}→左：00628_hidari⟧ (left) and ⟦{車線|しゃせん}→車線：18949_shasen⟧ (traffic lane). In Japan's left-hand traffic system, the {左車線|ひだりしゃせん} is the regular driving lane, while the ⟦{右車線|みぎしゃせん}→右車線：29256_migishasen⟧ is used for overtaking. This is the opposite of right-hand traffic countries.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {左車線|ひだりしゃせん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to merge into the left lane
- {左車線|ひだりしゃせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{走行|そうこう}→走行：14260_soukou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to drive in the left lane
- {左車線|ひだりしゃせん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{寄|よ}る→寄る：02440_yoru⟧: to move toward the left lane

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{右車線|みぎしゃせん}→右車線：29256_migishasen⟧: right lane — the overtaking lane in Japan
- ⟦{走行車線|そうこうしゃせん}→走行車線：24736_soukoushasen⟧: driving lane — the regular-speed lane
- ⟦{追越車線|おいこししゃせん}→追越車線：24737_oikoshishasen⟧: passing lane — the faster lane
